newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Highveld sees modest upturn in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Highveld sees modest upturn in 1997.

text.p: Highveld steel and Vanadium Corp Ltd said it expected a modest increase in earnings in 1997 after attributable income plunged to 69.45 million rand in 1996 from 200.85 million in 1995.

The company said world carbon steel consumption was forecast to by rise by over three percent this year. As a result, while oversupply would remain a factor, prices were clearly firming for most of group's key products, particularly vanadium, it said.

"The key elements will be the servicing of debt and the profitability of the stainless steel operation which is anticipating significantly better volumes, improved quality and and marginally higher prices," a statement with year results said.
"A modest increase in group earnings is expected in 1997."
